name: Snapmaker Luban
description: The original B tier should change to C for this snapshot. The source supports a user-confirmed electron-updater flow with same-channel sha512 metadata, but the Windows release configuration disables update code-signature verification. Therefore the recorded generalized OS signing trust-root statement is materially contradicted. C captures the observed application update channel without asserting that a release-wide signature policy is absent; the metadata checksum remains an integrity value whose trust source is not independently pinned.
limitations: Snapshot is commit db573f5dff3c6db2361e198d120fb3481088196b from a newly retrieved default branch, not the original study checkout.
The source shows one Windows configuration and framework metadata fields; it does not prove actual signatures, macOS/Linux enforcement, or every published release artifact.
No framework implementation or release artifact was executed or downloaded in this review.
